purpose: Deterministic acceptance fixtures for support, refute and incomplete-evidence semantics. These are not endpoint observations.

observations.label: Failures span multiple accounts
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents repeated failures across several target accounts from one source within a bounded time window.

observations.label: Known service context
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents a known service using an expired credential during an approved maintenance window.

observations.label: Origin context unavailable
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence intentionally leaves source address and workstation context unknown.

observations.label: Unusual trusted-binary command
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents a trusted Windows binary with a command pattern outside the approved administrative baseline.

observations.label: Approved deployment activity
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents a signed deployment process aligned with the authorized change window.

observations.label: Command line unavailable
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence intentionally leaves process command-line content unknown.

observations.label: Unexpected process lineage
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents a parent-child relationship outside the expected application workflow.

observations.label: Approved management automation
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence represents expected software-management execution with verified administrative context.

observations.label: Hash and parent context unavailable
observations.summary: Synthetic acceptance evidence intentionally leaves image hash and parent process context unknown.
